title: MicroLens Images 384 — Microscopy Specimens
subtitle: 75,491 PNGs at 384×384 · diatoms + fungal spores · MicroLens VQA companion
description:
The image companion to the **MicroLens VQA — Microscopy Q&A Dataset**. 75,491 microscopy specimen photographs, every one resize-and-padded to **384×384 RGB PNG**, ready to feed directly to a vision-language model without further preprocessing.

## Naming convention

Each filename encodes its provenance:

```
0051053_ude_diatoms_Planothidium.png
   ↑       ↑           ↑
   id      source      genus
```

Match this filename to the `image` field in the **MicroLens VQA — Microscopy Q&A Dataset** to recover the question/answer pair and full metadata.

## Source datasets — license-clean for commercial use

- **ude_diatoms** — University of Duisburg-Essen Diatoms in the Wild 2024 (Zenodo 10410655), CC0
- **diatlas** — open European diatom imaging (Zenodo 16260887), CC-BY 4.0
- **tgfc** — Tectona grandis Fungal Community (figshare 28855910), CC-BY 4.0

Only upstream sources whose licences unambiguously permit commercial reuse (CC0 or CC-BY 4.0) are included in this release.

## Preprocessing

- **Original resolutions varied wildly** — some sources were 1024×1024 scans, others were 200×200 thumbnails. All were resize-and-padded to a uniform 384×384 with white background, preserving aspect ratio. No cropping.
- **Background scrubbing**: stray UI text and watermark crops were removed manually for the top-30 genera; left as-is for the long-tail.
- **De-duplication**: perceptual hash + manual review removed near-duplicates.

## How to use

```python
from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/kaggle/input/microlens-images-hackathon/images_384_clean/0051053_ude_diatoms_Planothidium.png').convert('RGB')
# 384x384 RGB, ready for a vision-language model's image preprocessor
```
